svg.title: High availability
svg.desc: A wallet app reaches a managed load balancer that spreads requests across an API server in each of two zones. Postgres in zone A copies every write to a standby in zone B. Zone A goes dark, the load balancer sends everything to zone B, the standby is promoted, and uptime stays at 99.98 percent.
svg.text: Zone A goes dark. Traffic shifts to zone B, the standby takes over.
